messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — QuarryTech wants to onboard a private summarization model (13B) behind our VPC with HSM keying. They need version pinning, canary rollout, and continuous evals against PHI-redaction tests. Asking for a 2-week protected eval window.
Luis Ortega: Thanks — do we have capacity for a dedicated pool or should we suggest private deployment on their infra?
Maya Chen: They prefer Private (Redwood Private) for compliance. Ops wants a clear canary plan + fallback to hosted small model.
Priya Nair: PHI redaction tests: can we reuse the existing phi-redact-suite + add a customer-specific test set? Also need to confirm KMS/HSM vendor compatibility.
Ben Patel: I can schedule the eval window. Proposed timeline: week 0 — infra prep + model import; week 1 — smoke + safety evals; week 2 — canary traffic at 10->50%. Is that aligned?
Maya Chen: Yes. Customer also asked about latency SLOs (p95 < 450ms for 512 tokens). Can we meet that on private 13B in their tenant?
Luis Ortega: Depends on their GPU type. If they're on A10G-ish instances we should be close with quantized weights + batching. I'll draft a throughput/latency estimate.
Samir Rao: FYI — QuarryTech finance flagged renewal risk unless onboarding goes smooth. They want weekly check-ins during the eval.
Priya Nair: Security checklist: HSM integration runbook, audit-log forwarding, tokenization/PHI redaction step, and retention policy. Also need a signed DPA before data ingestion.
Ben Patel: Noted. I'll put together an onboarding runbook and checklist. Quick Q: any special model adapt steps (LoRA, finetune)?
Maya Chen: They want the base open-13B with a small on-device adapter (LoRA). We must confirm we support variant pinning and fallback to base if adapter fails.
Luis Ortega: For canary, suggest 2 routes: 1) 5% traffic to adapter variant + automated rollback on quality regressions; 2) 20% route to base quantized model as fallback. We can implement quality gates using the eval set.
onboard-bot: Reminder — please complete the "Private onboarding intake" form: https://redwood-internal/onboard/intake/1781239999 :clipboard:
Maya Chen: I'll fill the intake today and attach the customer's PHI test set (anonymized). Ben — can you own the weekly check-ins?
Ben Patel: Yep, I'll run weekly syncs and post notes here. First one Monday 10am PT.
Priya Nair: I'll coordinate with infra/security to validate HSM keywrap and audit log forwarding during week 0.
Luis Ortega: I'll have a latency/cost estimate by EOD tomorrow. If numbers look bad we'll propose a dedicated small-hosted pool as an alternative to private.
Maya Chen: Great — next steps: Ben publishes runbook link, Luis posts perf estimate, Priya confirms HSM vendor compatibility, I complete intake + upload testset. Thanks all :thumbsup:
